packages.summary: OpenOS home screen and app launcher.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS home screen, app grid, folders, icon ordering and app context menu.

packages.summary: OpenOS lock screen and passcode panel.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS lock screen, clock display and passcode interface.
Updates Control Center and its quick controls for connectivity, brightness and system actions.
Updates Settings with signed firmware OTA, release notes, rollback, update-source controls and scrolling system preferences.

packages.summary: Browse and open files on the SD card.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS file browser and file launching interface.
Updates the OpenOS clock application and its time display.
Updates the OpenOS calculator interface and calculation logic.

packages.summary: Create and edit notes on the SD card.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS notes application, multiline editor and note browser.
Updates OpenStore with version compatibility checks, Update All, user applications, system application updates and OPK package management.

packages.summary: Current conditions, next hours and five days.
packages.description: Weather for the place chosen in Settings or with the pin button: current temperature, feels-like, humidity and wind, the next twelve hours and a five-day outlook from Open-Meteo (no key needed). Also feeds the lock screen widget.

packages.summary: Rotating 3D cube demo for the OSA SDK.
packages.description: A lightweight rotating 3D cube that demonstrates the OSA pseudo-3D API. Tap the viewport to switch between wireframe, solid and solid-with-edges rendering modes.

packages.summary: Dodge the red cube on a full-screen 3D road.
packages.description: A lightweight three-lane 3D runner. Tap the left or right side of the screen to change lane, avoid incoming cubes and survive as the speed increases.

packages.summary: One-player Pong on the whole screen.
packages.description: A fast one-player Pong game designed for the OpenOS touchscreen. Drag the paddle, keep the ball in play and beat your best score.

packages.summary: Widgets, dialogs and custom shapes from OSA SDK 4.
packages.description: A tour of the immediate-mode widgets (buttons, switches, checkboxes, radios, progress, chips), the redesigned system dialog and the custom shape calls (stars, polygons, pies, per-corner rounded rectangles and animated paths) added in OSA SDK 4. A reference for app developers.

packages.summary: Full-screen 3D scene with five orbiting shapes.
packages.description: Five shapes orbiting on a grid, depth-sorted as one scene and rendered through a 240x40 band buffer so the whole 240x320 screen is drawn at 16-bit colour. Drag to orbit the camera, tap to switch between wireframe, solid and solid-with-edges. The reference for the OSA SDK 5 scene API.

packages.summary: Shows a computer screen streamed over Wi-Fi.
packages.description: Turns the device into a small second display: run tools/cast_sender.py from the OpenStore repository on a computer and its screen is streamed over a plain TCP connection as RGB565 tiles. Built entirely from the OSA SDK 6 building blocks: net.listen/accept/recv, byte buffers and screen.write. Needs the Network permission.
